text:
Rina K.: Hi @people-ops — quick ask. I need a recurring 15-minute prayer break during the workday (around 12:45pm PT) starting next week, and I also have travel the week of Apr 5 so I need to swap my oncall that week. What's the preferred process for a religious accommodation? :pray:
Sam Pritchard: Thanks for the heads-up Rina — totally fine to discuss. Can you confirm the daily time window you need and whether the oncall swap is just for that one week? Also cc'ing Nora from People Ops.
Nora (People Ops): Hi Rina — we can support religious accommodations. Documentation isn't always required but helpful for records. Options: 1) recurring short break with calendar entry + teammate coverage, 2) formal accommodation form if you'd like an official record, 3) temporary oncall swap for Apr 5 week. We can help with the swap and with notifying payroll/people systems if needed.
Rina K.: Thanks Nora — daily 12:45–1:00pm PT works. Yes the oncall swap only for week of Apr 5. I can swap with someone who volunteers, but wanted to make sure we follow the right steps.
Ben - Facilities: We have a small private room in 3B that people book for short prayers/meditation. I can reserve recurring 15-min blocks for Rina if you want. Booking link: https://redwood.internal/facilities/rooms/3B (or ping me and I'll add it).
Jorge V.: For oncall coverage: if Priya is ok to cover that week we can do a one-off rotation edit. We try to avoid gaps in alert coverage — Priya, would you be able to swap weeks?
Priya R.: I can take the Apr 5 week, no problem. Rina, send me the calendar invite and I’ll confirm in the rota tool.
Rina K.: Thank you Priya! I'll send the invite now. Nora — should I fill out the accommodation form or is this fine as an informal agreement?
Nora (People Ops): Either works. If you want an official accommodation (keeps it on file for future cycles), please fill the short form: https://redwood.internal/accommodations/new — otherwise we’ll log this as an agreed workplace adjustment. Either way, we will not change your performance expectations; if any oncall impacts require temporary shift changes we’ll coordinate with your manager so performance reviews aren't affected.
Sam Pritchard: Sounds good. Please include me on the calendar invite and note the swap in the rota. For the rota change we usually run: `rotation swap --from Rina_K --to Priya_R --week 2026-04-05` — ops will take care of the backend change once Priya confirms. :thumbsup:
accommodations-bot: New accommodation request received for Rina K. — status: pending (People Ops review).
Nora (People Ops): I’ll follow up with a quick confirmation email and add the room booking. If Rina wants the formal form, I’ll mark it confidential and add to her record.
Rina K.: Appreciate everyone's help — calendar invite sent to Priya and Sam, and I submitted the accommodation form just now. Thanks all. :pray:
Sam Pritchard: Thanks Rina — we’ll handle the rota change and facilities booking.
Ben - Facilities: Room booked for recurring 12:45–1:00pm PT in 3B, invites going out now.
Jorge V.: Noted — oncall rota updated after Priya confirmation. Everyone good here.
Nora (People Ops): Closing loop: accommodation logged, room reserved, oncall swap scheduled. Reach out if anything else pops up.
Rina K.: Closing thread — thanks again!
